title: Glowing pretzel
svg:

  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='2.4' fill='#FFF6D8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.6' fill='#FFF6D8'/>
</svg>
